import types

import pytest

import _pytest.mark.evaluate as evaluate
from _pytest.mark.structures import Mark
from _pytest.outcomes import Failed


class DummyConfig:
    pass


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=None, obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks or [])
        self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=None, obj=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj)


def test_compiled_eval_simple_expression():
    assert evaluate.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True


def test_compiled_eval_uses_provided_globals():
    d = {"x": 10}
    assert evaluate.compiled_eval("x * 2", d) == 20


def test_bool_false_when_no_matching_marks():
    item = make_item(marks=[make_mark(name="other")])
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is False


def test_bool_true_when_matching_marks_exist():
    item = make_item(marks=[make_mark(name="skipif")])
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True


def test_wasvalid_initially_true():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True


def test_get_marks_filters_by_name():
    marks = [make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="xfail"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=marks), "skipif")
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert got == [marks[0], marks[2]]


def test_invalidraise_without_raises_returns_none():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"reason": "x"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(ValueError()) is None


def test_invalidraise_with_matching_exception_returns_false():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": ValueError})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(ValueError()) is False


def test_invalidraise_with_non_matching_exception_returns_true():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": ValueError})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(TypeError()) is True


def test_getglobals_contains_standard_entries():
    item = make_item()
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    g = ev._getglobals()
    assert g["os"] is evaluate.os
    assert g["sys"] is evaluate.sys
    assert g["platform"] is evaluate.platform
    assert g["config"] is item.config


def test_getglobals_includes_test_function_globals_when_obj_present():
    sentinel = object()

    def func():
        return None

    func.__globals__["SENTINEL_FOR_EVAL_TEST"] = sentinel
    try:
        item = make_item(obj=func)
        ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
        g = ev._getglobals()
        assert g["SENTINEL_FOR_EVAL_TEST"] is sentinel
    finally:
        del func.__globals__["SENTINEL_FOR_EVAL_TEST"]


def test_istrue_returns_cached_result_without_recomputing():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    ev.result = True
    assert ev._istrue() is True


def test_istrue_no_marks_is_false():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert ev.result is False


def test_istrue_empty_args_mark_is_true_and_sets_reason():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "because"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "because"


def test_istrue_string_expression_true_sets_reason_and_expr():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 1",), kwargs={"reason": "yes"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "yes"
    assert ev.expr == "1 == 1"


def test_istrue_string_expression_false_returns_false_and_tracks_expr():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 2",))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert ev.result is False
    assert ev.expr == "1 == 2"


def test_istrue_uses_condition_kwarg_instead_of_args():
    mark = make_mark(
        name="skipif",
        args=("1 == 2",),
        kwargs={"condition": "2 == 2", "reason": "kw condition"},
    )
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.expr == "2 == 2"
    assert ev.reason == "kw condition"


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_requires_reason():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(True,))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(Failed) as excinfo:
        ev._istrue()
    assert "you need to specify reason=STRING when using booleans as conditions." in str(excinfo.value)


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_with_reason_true():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(1,), kwargs={"reason": "bool reason"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "bool reason"
    assert ev.expr == 1


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_with_reason_false():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(0,), kwargs={"reason": "bool reason"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert ev.result is False
    assert ev.expr == 0


def test_istrue_multiple_expressions_stops_at_first_true():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0", "1"), kwargs={"reason": "second true"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.expr == "1"
    assert ev.reason == "second true"


def test_istrue_multiple_marks_uses_first_true_mark():
    m1 = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"})
    m2 = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "second"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[m1, m2]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev._mark == m2
    assert ev.reason == "second"


def test_get_returns_default_when_no_current_mark():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev.get("reason", "default") == "default"


def test_get_returns_mark_kwarg_value():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "abc"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.get("reason") == "abc"


def test_getexplanation_prefers_reason_attribute():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "from mark"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    ev._mark = mark
    ev.reason = "from attr"
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "from attr"


def test_getexplanation_uses_mark_reason_when_no_reason_attr():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "from mark"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "from mark"


def test_getexplanation_empty_when_no_reason_and_no_expr():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev.getexplanation() == ""


def test_getexplanation_condition_prefix_when_only_expr():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    ev.expr = "x > 1"
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "condition: x > 1"


def test_istrue_string_expression_can_access_function_globals():
    def func():
        return None

    func.__globals__["VISIBLE_NAME_FOR_EVAL_TEST"] = 42
    try:
        mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("VISIBLE_NAME_FOR_EVAL_TEST == 42",))
        ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark], obj=func), "skipif")
        assert ev._istrue() is True
    finally:
        del func.__globals__["VISIBLE_NAME_FOR_EVAL_TEST"]


def test_istrue_string_expression_can_access_config():
    config = types.SimpleNamespace(flag=True)
    item = DummyItem(
        marks=[make_mark(name="skipif", args=("config.flag",), kwargs={"reason": "cfg"})],
        config=config,
    )
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "cfg"


def test_istrue_caches_false_result():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",))
    item = make_item(marks=[mark])
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",))]
    assert ev._istrue() is False


def test_istrue_caches_true_result():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",))
    item = make_item(marks=[mark])
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    item._marks = []
    assert ev._istrue() is True


def test_istrue_records_marks_list():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    ev._istrue()
    assert ev._marks == [mark]


def test_istrue_sets_current_mark_during_iteration():
    m1 = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",))
    m2 = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[m1, m2]), "skipif")
    ev._istrue()
    assert ev._mark == m2


def test_istrue_syntax_error_translates_to_failed_and_marks_invalid():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("(",))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(Failed) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    text = str(excinfo.value)
    assert "Error evaluating 'skipif' expression" in text
    assert "SyntaxError: invalid syntax" in text
    assert ev.wasvalid() is False


def test_istrue_name_error_translates_to_failed_and_marks_invalid():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("does_not_exist_name",))
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=[mark]), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(Failed) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    text = str(excinfo.value)
    assert "Error evaluating 'skipif' expression" in text
    assert "does_not_exist_name" in text
    assert "NameError" in text
    assert ev.wasvalid() is False

import sys
import types

import pytest

import _pytest.mark.evaluate as evaluate
from _pytest.mark.structures import Mark
from _pytest.outcomes import Failed


class DummyConfig:
    pass


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj)


def make_function_with_globals():
    external_value = 42

    def f():
        return external_value

    return f


def test_compiled_eval_basic_expression():
    result = evaluate.compiled_eval("1 + 2 * 3", {})
    assert result == 7


def test_compiled_eval_uses_provided_globals():
    ns = {"x": 10, "y": 5}
    assert evaluate.compiled_eval("x - y", ns) == 5


def test_bool_reflects_presence_of_matching_marks():
    item = make_item([make_mark(name="other")])
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is False

    item2 = make_item([make_mark(name="skipif")])
    ev2 = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item2, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev2) is True


def test_wasvalid_true_before_any_error():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True


def test_get_marks_filters_by_name():
    marks = [
        make_mark(name="skipif"),
        make_mark(name="xfail"),
        make_mark(name="skipif"),
    ]
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks), "skipif")
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert all(m.name == "skipif" for m in got)


def test_invalidraise_none_when_no_raises_kwarg():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"reason": "r"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(ValueError()) is None


def test_invalidraise_false_when_exception_matches():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": ValueError})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(ValueError()) is False


def test_invalidraise_true_when_exception_does_not_match():
    mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": ValueError})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "xfail")
    ev._mark = mark
    assert ev.invalidraise(TypeError()) is True


def test_getglobals_contains_standard_names_and_config():
    item = make_item()
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is evaluate.os
    assert d["sys"] is evaluate.sys
    assert d["platform"] is evaluate.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config


def test_getglobals_includes_test_function_globals():
    func = make_function_with_globals()
    item = make_item(obj=func)
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert "__name__" in d
    assert "make_function_with_globals" in d


def test_istrue_no_marks_is_false():
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False


def test_istrue_empty_args_mark_is_true_and_sets_reason():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "empty means true"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "empty means true"


def test_istrue_string_condition_true_sets_reason_and_expr():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 1",), kwargs={"reason": "yes"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "yes"
    assert ev.expr == "1 == 1"


def test_istrue_string_condition_false_returns_false():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 2",), kwargs={"reason": "no"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert ev.result is False


def test_istrue_uses_condition_kwarg_instead_of_args():
    mark = make_mark(
        name="skipif",
        args=("1 == 2",),
        kwargs={"condition": "2 == 2", "reason": "kwarg wins"},
    )
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.expr == "2 == 2"
    assert ev.reason == "kwarg wins"


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_requires_reason():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(True,), kwargs={})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(Failed) as excinfo:
        ev._istrue()
    assert "you need to specify reason=STRING when using booleans as conditions." in str(excinfo.value)


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_with_reason_true():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(1,), kwargs={"reason": "truthy"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "truthy"
    assert ev.expr == 1


def test_istrue_boolean_condition_with_reason_false():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=(0,), kwargs={"reason": "falsy"})
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert ev.result is False


def test_istrue_multiple_expressions_stops_on_first_true():
    mark = make_mark(
        name="skipif",
        args=("0", "1", "2"),
        kwargs={"reason": "second one true"},
    )
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark]), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.expr == "1"
    assert ev.reason == "second one true"


def test_istrue_multiple_marks_uses_later_true_mark():
    marks = [
        make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
        make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
    ]
    ev = evaluate.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "second"
    assert ev._mark is marks[1]


def test_istrue_caches_result():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "cached"})
    item = make_item([mark])

        for mark in self._marks:

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")

class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123

    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5

    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False


def test_bool_does_not_cache_marker_changes():
    item = make_item([make_mark()], obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    item._marks = [make_mark(name="other")]
    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(), make_mark()]
    assert bool(ev) is True

import types

import pytest

class DummyConfig:
    pass

        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123

    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

        make_mark(name="skipif", args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"}),
        make_mark(name="xfail"),
        make_mark(name="skipif"),

    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys

    assert d2["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d2["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d2["config"] is no_obj_item.config

class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):

class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)

            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:

def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

def sample_function():

sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123

    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5

    item._marks = [make_mark(name="other")]

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

import importlib
import types
import pytest
sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

def make_mark(name='skipif', args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

    return None
sample_function.__globals__['SAMPLE_GLOBAL'] = 123

def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_builtins_and_config():
    assert sut.compiled_eval('1 + 2 == 3', {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval('value * 2', {'value': 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval('config.value', {'config': DummyConfig('seen')}) == 'seen'
    assert sut.compiled_eval('len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)', {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval('sorted({3, 1, 2})', {}) == [1, 2, 3]

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_builtins_and_config():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_compiled_eval_returns_non_bool_values():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1


def test_bool_get_marks_and_wasvalid_and_no_matching():
    marks = [make_mark(name="other"), make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    item = make_item(marks=marks)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False


def test_bool_does_not_cache_marker_changes():
    item = make_item([make_mark()], obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    item._marks = [make_mark(name="other")]
    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(), make_mark()]
    assert bool(ev) is True


def test_bool_true_when_matching_mark_exists_even_if_condition_false():
    item = make_item([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"})])

def test_getglobals_without_obj_has_standard_names():

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    d = ev._getglobals()

    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d

    sentinel_os = object()

    f.__globals__["SPECIAL_NAME"] = 7
    f.__globals__["os"] = sentinel_os

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(obj=f), "skipif")
    d = ev._getglobals()

import importlib
import types
import pytest
sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

def make_mark(name='skipif', args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

def sample_function():
    return None
sample_function.__globals__['SAMPLE_GLOBAL'] = 123

def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_builtins_and_config():
    assert sut.compiled_eval('1 + 2 == 3', {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval('value * 2', {'value': 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval('config.value', {'config': DummyConfig('seen')}) == 'seen'
    assert sut.compiled_eval('len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)', {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval('sorted({3, 1, 2})', {}) == [1, 2, 3]

def test_compiled_eval_returns_non_bool_values():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == 'aaa'
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

def test_bool_get_marks_and_wasvalid_and_no_matching():
    marks = [make_mark(name='other'), make_mark(name='skipif'), make_mark(name='skipif')]
    item = make_item(marks=marks)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, 'skipif')
    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ['skipif', 'skipif']
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name='other')]), 'skipif')) is False

def test_bool_does_not_cache_marker_changes():
    item = make_item([make_mark()], obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, 'skipif')
    assert bool(ev) is True
    item._marks = [make_mark(name='other')]
    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(), make_mark()]
    assert bool(ev) is True

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def syntax_text(expr):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return ev, str(excinfo.value)


def nonsyntax_text(expr, name="skipif", obj=sample_function):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name=name, args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=obj), name)
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return ev, str(excinfo.value)


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_nonbool():

    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

import importlib
import types
import pytest
sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

def make_mark(name='skipif', args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

def sample_function():
    return None
sample_function.__globals__['SAMPLE_GLOBAL'] = 123

def syntax_text(expr):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function), 'skipif')
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

def nonsyntax_text(expr, name='skipif', obj=sample_function):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name=name, args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=obj), name)
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_cases():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

    assert bool(ev) is True
    assert [m.name for m in ev._get_marks()] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False

    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(), make_mark()]
    assert bool(ev) is True

    assert ev.invalidraise(TypeError()) is False

sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_globals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_bool_get_marks_wasvalid_and_no_obj_getglobals():
    marks = [make_mark(name="other"), make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    item = make_item(marks=marks)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True

    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d

    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123

    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    pass


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_bool_marks_and_getglobals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

    marks = [
        make_mark(name="skipif", args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"}),
        make_mark(name="xfail"),
        make_mark(name="skipif"),
    ]
    item = make_item(marks=marks, obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")

    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]

    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert d["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] == 123

    no_obj_item = make_item()
    d2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(no_obj_item, "skipif")._getglobals()
    assert d2["os"] is sut.os
    assert d2["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d2["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d2["config"] is no_obj_item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d2

    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False
    assert sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif").wasvalid() is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "marks,obj,expected,result_attr,expr,reason,explanation,custom",
    [
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 1",), kwargs={"reason": "because"})], sample_function, True, True, "1 == 1", "because", "because", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 2",), kwargs={"reason": "nope"})], sample_function, False, False, "1 == 2", None, "nope", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"condition": "2 > 1", "reason": "kwcond"})], sample_function, True, True, "2 > 1", "kwcond", "kwcond", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(1,), kwargs={"reason": "bool"})], None, True, True, 1, "bool", "bool", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs={"reason": "empty"})], None, True, True, None, "empty", "empty", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0", "3 > 2"), kwargs={"reason": "second"})], sample_function, True, True, "3 > 2", "second", "second", None),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("config is not None",), kwargs={"reason": "cfg"})], None, True, True, "config is not None", "cfg", "cfg", None),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            True,
            True,
            "1",
            "second",
            "second",
            None,
        ),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("False",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            False,
            False,
            "False",
            None,
            "second",
            None,
        ),

        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "r", "custom": 42})], sample_function, True, True, "1", "r", "r", 42),
    ],
)
def test_istrue_success_false_paths_cache_and_current_mark(marks, obj, expected, result_attr, expr, reason, explanation, custom):
    if obj == "special":
        def f():
            return None
        f.__globals__["SPECIAL_NAME"] = 7
        obj = f

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks, obj=obj), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is expected
    assert ev.result is result_attr
    if expr is not None:
        assert ev.expr == expr
    if reason is not None:
        assert ev.reason == reason
    assert ev.getexplanation() == explanation
    if marks:
        assert ev._mark is marks[-1] if expected is False and len(marks) > 1 else ev._mark is not None
    if custom is not None:
        assert ev.get("custom") == custom

    original_item = ev.item
    ev.item = make_item([])
    assert ev._istrue() is expected
    ev.item = original_item

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    pass


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def special_function():
    return None


special_function.__globals__["SPECIAL_NAME"] = 7


def test_compiled_eval_getglobals_and_bool_marker_staleness():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

    marks = [
        make_mark(name="skipif", args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"}),
        make_mark(name="xfail"),
        make_mark(name="skipif"),
    ]
    item = make_item(marks=marks, obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")

    assert bool(ev) is True
    assert [m.name for m in ev._get_marks()] == ["skipif", "skipif"]

    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert d["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] == 123

    no_obj_item = make_item()
    d2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(no_obj_item, "skipif")._getglobals()
    assert d2["os"] is sut.os
    assert d2["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d2["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d2["config"] is no_obj_item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d2

    item._marks = [make_mark(name="other")]
    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    assert bool(ev) is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")) is False
    assert sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif").wasvalid() is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "marks,obj,expected,expr,has_reason,explanation",
    [
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 1",), kwargs={"reason": "because"})], sample_function, True, "1 == 1", True, "because"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 2",), kwargs={"reason": "nope"})], sample_function, False, "1 == 2", False, "nope"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"condition": "2 > 1", "reason": "kwcond"})], sample_function, True, "2 > 1", True, "kwcond"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(1,), kwargs={"reason": "bool"})], None, True, 1, True, "bool"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs={"reason": "empty"})], None, True, None, True, "empty"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0", "3 > 2"), kwargs={"reason": "second"})], sample_function, True, "3 > 2", True, "second"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("config is not None",), kwargs={"reason": "cfg"})], None, True, "config is not None", True, "cfg"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("SPECIAL_NAME == 7",), kwargs={"reason": "global"})], special_function, True, "SPECIAL_NAME == 7", True, "global"),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            True,
            "1",
            True,
            "second",
        ),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("False",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            False,
            "False",
            False,
            "second",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_istrue_paths_and_cache(marks, obj, expected, expr, has_reason, explanation):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks, obj=obj), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is expected
    assert ev.result is expected
    if expr is not None:
        assert ev.expr == expr
    if has_reason:
        assert ev.reason == explanation
    else:
        assert not hasattr(ev, "reason")
    assert ev.getexplanation() == explanation

    ev.item = make_item([], obj=obj)
    assert ev._istrue() is expected

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is False
    assert not hasattr(ev, "result")

    ev.result = False
    assert ev._istrue() is False

    assert ev.get("reason", "default") == "default"
    ev.expr = "x > 1"
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "condition: x > 1"
    ev.expr = 0
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "condition: 0"
    ev.expr = ["a", 2]
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "condition: ['a', 2]"

    ev.reason = "attr reason"
    ev._mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "mark reason"})
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "attr reason"
    assert ev.get("reason") == "mark reason"

    ev2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    ev2._mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "mark reason"})
    assert ev2.getexplanation() == "mark reason"

    ev3 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev3.getexplanation() == ""

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(True,), kwargs={})]), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev._istrue()

    ev2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "xfail")
    ev2._mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={})
    assert ev2.invalidraise(ValueError()) is None
    ev2._mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": ValueError, "other": "x"})
    assert ev2.invalidraise(ValueError()) is False
    assert ev2.invalidraise(TypeError()) is True
    assert ev2.get("other") == "x"
    assert ev2.get("missing", 99) == 99
    ev2._mark = make_mark(name="xfail", kwargs={"raises": (ValueError, TypeError)})
    assert ev2.invalidraise(ValueError()) is False
    assert ev2.invalidraise(TypeError()) is False
    assert ev2.invalidraise(RuntimeError()) is True
    ev2._mark = None
    assert ev2.get("other", "fallback") == "fallback"


def test_current_mark_custom_get_and_condition_kwarg_false():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "r", "custom": 42})
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.get("custom") == 42
    assert ev._mark is mark
    assert ev.expr == "1"
    assert ev.reason == "r"

    mark2 = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"condition": "0", "custom": "v"})
    ev2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark2], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    assert ev2._istrue() is False
    assert ev2.result is False
    assert ev2.expr == "0"
    assert ev2.get("custom") == "v"
    assert ev2.get("missing", "fallback") == "fallback"
    assert ev2.getexplanation() == "condition: 0"


def test_istrue_rewraps_non_syntax_test_outcome():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("pytest.fail('boom')",), kwargs={})
    item = make_item([mark], obj=types.SimpleNamespace(__globals__={"pytest": pytest}))
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    assert ev.wasvalid() is False
    text = str(excinfo.value)
    assert "Error evaluating 'skipif' expression" in text
    assert "pytest.fail('boom')" in text
    assert "Failed: boom" in text
    assert "Traceback" not in text


def test_istrue_rewraps_syntax_error_with_pointer_message():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("(",), kwargs={})
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    assert ev.wasvalid() is False
    assert isinstance(ev.exc[1], SyntaxError)
    assert ev.exc[1].offset == 2
    text = str(excinfo.value)
    assert "Error evaluating 'skipif' expression" in text
    assert "\n    (\n" in text
    assert "\n       ^\nSyntaxError: invalid syntax" in text
    pointer_line = [line for line in text.splitlines() if "^" in line][0]
    assert pointer_line == "       ^"
    assert len(pointer_line) == ev.exc[1].offset + 5


def test_cached_true_short_circuits_later_errors():
    mark = make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "cached"})
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([mark], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.result is True
    ev.item = make_item([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("(",), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function)
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.reason == "cached"
    assert ev.expr == "1"


def test_get_marks_empty_and_bool_false_for_other_name():
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "xfail")
    assert ev._get_marks() == []
    assert bool(ev) is False
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False


def test_getexplanation_prefers_reason_over_expr_and_empty_without_expr():
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    ev.expr = 5
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "condition: 5"
    ev._mark = make_mark(name="skipif", kwargs={"reason": "mark reason"})
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "mark reason"
    ev.reason = "attr reason"
    assert ev.getexplanation() == "attr reason"
    ev2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif")
    assert ev2.getexplanation() == ""

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def syntax_text(expr):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function), "skipif")
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return ev, str(excinfo.value)


def nonsyntax_text(expr, name="skipif", obj=sample_function):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name=name, args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=obj), name)
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return ev, str(excinfo.value)


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_nonbool():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1


def test_bool_get_marks_wasvalid_and_name_filtering():

    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False
    got2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(
        make_item([make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="xfail"), make_mark(name="skipif")]), "xfail"
    )._get_marks()
    assert len(got2) == 1
    assert got2[0].name == "xfail"

import importlib
import types
import pytest
sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

def make_mark(name='skipif', args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

def sample_function():
    return None
sample_function.__globals__['SAMPLE_GLOBAL'] = 123

def syntax_text(expr):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function), 'skipif')
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

def nonsyntax_text(expr, name='skipif', obj=sample_function):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name=name, args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=obj), name)
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_nonbool():
    assert sut.compiled_eval('1 + 2 == 3', {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval('value * 2', {'value': 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval('config.value', {'config': DummyConfig('seen')}) == 'seen'
    assert sut.compiled_eval('len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)', {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval('sorted({3, 1, 2})', {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == 'aaa'
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

def test_bool_get_marks_wasvalid_and_name_filtering():
    marks = [make_mark(name='other'), make_mark(name='skipif'), make_mark(name='skipif')]
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=marks), 'skipif')
    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ['skipif', 'skipif']
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name='other')]), 'skipif')) is False
    got2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name='skipif'), make_mark(name='xfail'), make_mark(name='skipif')]), 'xfail')._get_marks()
    assert len(got2) == 1
    assert got2[0].name == 'xfail'

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_globals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_compiled_eval_builtins_and_expression_result_types():

import importlib

class DummyConfig:

        self._marks = list(marks)

            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):

def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_globals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True

    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform

    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_cases():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1
    marker = object()
    assert sut.compiled_eval("marker", {"marker": marker}) is marker

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_cases():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

    assert sut.compiled_eval("marker", {"marker": marker}) is marker

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_globals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_bool_get_marks_wasvalid_and_no_obj_getglobals():
    marks = [make_mark(name="other"), make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    item = make_item(marks=marks)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False


def test_getglobals_includes_obj_globals_and_expression_uses_them_and_overrides():
    def f():
        return None

    sentinel_os = object()

    f.__globals__["SPECIAL_NAME"] = 7
    f.__globals__["os"] = sentinel_os
    f.__globals__["platform"] = sentinel_platform
    item = make_item(
        [make_mark(args=("SPECIAL_NAME == 7 and config.value == 'cfg'",), kwargs={"reason": "global"})],
        obj=f,
    )
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["SPECIAL_NAME"] == 7
    assert d["os"] is sentinel_os
    assert d["platform"] is sentinel_platform
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert ev._istrue() is True
    assert ev.expr == "SPECIAL_NAME == 7 and config.value == 'cfg'"

import importlib
import types
import pytest
sut = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.evaluate')
Mark = importlib.import_module('_pytest.mark.structures').Mark

class DummyConfig:

    def __init__(self, value='cfg'):
        self.value = value

class DummyItem:

    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark

def make_mark(name='skipif', args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))

def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)

def sample_function():
    return None
sample_function.__globals__['SAMPLE_GLOBAL'] = 123

def syntax_text(expr):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=sample_function), 'skipif')
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

def nonsyntax_text(expr, name='skipif', obj=sample_function):
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name=name, args=(expr,), kwargs={})], obj=obj), name)
    with pytest.raises(sut.TEST_OUTCOME) as excinfo:
        ev.istrue()
    return (ev, str(excinfo.value))

def test_compiled_eval_basic_and_nonbool():
    assert sut.compiled_eval('1 + 2 == 3', {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval('value * 2', {'value': 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval('config.value', {'config': DummyConfig('seen')}) == 'seen'
    assert sut.compiled_eval('len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)', {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval('sorted({3, 1, 2})', {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == 'aaa'
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1

def test_bool_get_marks_wasvalid_and_name_filtering():

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    pass


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_marks_bool_and_getglobals():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10

    marks = [
        make_mark(name="skipif", args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"}),
        make_mark(name="xfail"),
        make_mark(name="skipif"),
    ]
    item = make_item(marks=marks, obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")

    assert bool(ev) is True
    got = ev._get_marks()
    assert len(got) == 2
    assert [m.name for m in got] == ["skipif", "skipif"]

    d = ev._getglobals()
    assert d["os"] is sut.os
    assert d["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d["config"] is item.config
    assert d["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] == 123

    no_obj_item = make_item()
    d2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(no_obj_item, "skipif")._getglobals()
    assert d2["os"] is sut.os
    assert d2["sys"] is sut.sys
    assert d2["platform"] is sut.platform
    assert d2["config"] is no_obj_item.config
    assert "SAMPLE_GLOBAL" not in d2

    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False
    assert sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(), "skipif").wasvalid() is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "marks,obj,expected,result_attr,expr,reason,explanation",
    [
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 1",), kwargs={"reason": "because"})], sample_function, True, True, "1 == 1", "because", "because"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1 == 2",), kwargs={"reason": "nope"})], sample_function, False, False, "1 == 2", None, "nope"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"condition": "2 > 1", "reason": "kwcond"})], sample_function, True, True, "2 > 1", "kwcond", "kwcond"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(1,), kwargs={"reason": "bool"})], None, True, True, 1, "bool", "bool"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs={"reason": "empty"})], None, True, True, None, "empty", "empty"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0", "3 > 2"), kwargs={"reason": "second"})], sample_function, True, True, "3 > 2", "second", "second"),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("config is not None",), kwargs={"reason": "cfg"})], None, True, True, "config is not None", "cfg", "cfg"),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            True,
            True,
            "1",
            "second",
            "second",
        ),
        (
            [
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "first"}),
                make_mark(name="skipif", args=("False",), kwargs={"reason": "second"}),
            ],
            sample_function,
            False,
            False,
            "False",
            None,
            "second",
        ),
        ([make_mark(name="skipif", args=("SPECIAL_NAME == 7",), kwargs={"reason": "global"})], "special", True, True, "SPECIAL_NAME == 7", "global", "global"),
    ],
)
def test_istrue_success_false_paths_cache_and_current_mark(marks, obj, expected, result_attr, expr, reason, explanation):
    if obj == "special":
        def f():
            return None
        f.__globals__["SPECIAL_NAME"] = 7
        obj = f

import importlib
import types

import pytest

sut = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.evaluate")
Mark = importlib.import_module("_pytest.mark.structures").Mark


class DummyConfig:
    def __init__(self, value="cfg"):
        self.value = value


class DummyItem:
    def __init__(self, marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
        self._marks = list(marks)
        if obj is not None:
            self.obj = obj
        self.config = config if config is not None else DummyConfig()

    def iter_markers(self, name=None):
        for mark in self._marks:
            if name is None or mark.name == name:
                yield mark


def make_mark(name="skipif", args=(), kwargs=None):
    return Mark(name=name, args=tuple(args), kwargs=dict(kwargs or {}))


def make_item(marks=(), obj=None, config=None):
    return DummyItem(marks=marks, obj=obj, config=config)


def sample_function():
    return None


sample_function.__globals__["SAMPLE_GLOBAL"] = 123


def test_compiled_eval_basic_cases():
    assert sut.compiled_eval("1 + 2 == 3", {}) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("value * 2", {"value": 5}) == 10
    assert sut.compiled_eval("config.value", {"config": DummyConfig("seen")}) == "seen"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("len([1, 2, 3]) + min(5, 2)", {}) == 5
    assert sut.compiled_eval("sorted({3, 1, 2})", {}) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert sut.compiled_eval("'a' * 3", {}) == "aaa"
    assert sut.compiled_eval("{'x': 1}['x']", {}) == 1
    marker = object()
    assert sut.compiled_eval("marker", {"marker": marker}) is marker


def test_compiled_eval_can_access_provided_modules_and_builtins():
    d = {"os": sut.os, "sys": sut.sys, "platform": sut.platform}
    assert sut.compiled_eval("os.path is not None and sys.version_info[0] >= 3", d) is True
    assert sut.compiled_eval("platform.system() == platform.system()", d) is True


def test_bool_get_marks_and_wasvalid():
    marks = [make_mark(name="other"), make_mark(name="skipif"), make_mark(name="skipif")]
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(marks=marks), "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    assert [m.name for m in ev._get_marks()] == ["skipif", "skipif"]
    assert ev.wasvalid() is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(name="other")]), "skipif")) is False


def test_bool_does_not_cache_marker_changes():
    item = make_item([make_mark()], obj=sample_function)
    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    item._marks = [make_mark(name="other")]
    assert bool(ev) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(), make_mark()]
    assert bool(ev) is True

    ev = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([make_mark(args=(False,), kwargs={"reason": "x"})]), "skipif")
    assert bool(ev) is True
    assert bool(sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item([]), "skipif")) is False

    item = make_item([make_mark(args=("1",), kwargs={"reason": "r"})], obj=sample_function)
    ev2 = sut.MarkEvaluator(item, "skipif")
    assert ev2._istrue() is True
    item._marks = []
    assert bool(ev2) is False
    item._marks = [make_mark(args=("0",), kwargs={"reason": "new"})]
    assert bool(ev2) is True

    d = sut.MarkEvaluator(make_item(obj=f, config=DummyConfig("real")), "skipif")._getglobals()
    assert d["config"] is fake_config

    ns = types.SimpleNamespace(__globals__={"alpha": 10, "config": "shadow"})

    ns2 = types.SimpleNamespace(__globals__={"os": "O", "sys": "S", "platform": "P", "config": "C"})
